text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the first leg in the Classic campaign, the Satsuki Sho.
The atmosphere around the racetrack was buzzing—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
That GⅡ race the other day was amazing!
Orfevre!
It was a truly perfect race!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: In this year's Classic campaign, can Orfe really pull it off? I'd love to see it—the moment a Triple Crown Umamusume is born!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It became a journey where phrases like that
could be heard here and there along the way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu,
so we ended up running in the Satsuki Sho after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Win Variation's growth was
far beyond expectations... and after discussing it,
we ended up submitting the entry after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's not what I meant!
I just... kind of felt like I was running away a bit myself, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Knowing we can fight fair and square
actually feels totally refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: N-No, wait...! That... was actually how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, since I'm entering, I plan to win.
Trainer gave me their seal of approval,
so I'm sure I can put up a good fight...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll go give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat Orfevre.
Hoisting that banner high,
the Satsuki Sho had begun."
